effect.shortEffect: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.
effect.full: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

french.ttm: Quand il rejoint le combat, ce Pokémon est aux petits\nsoins avec son allié et restaure quelques PV.

english.ttm: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

japanese.ttm: 登場したとき　味方を　もてなして HPを　少しだけ　回復してあげる。
